answer: One mechanism is a stake-and-slash bond. Every agent that settles trades must lock a refundable deposit in a bonded clearing account, a financial harbor where fees clear. Identities are free, but each must hold its stake for a glacier-slow cooldown before it can transact, so ten thousand sock-puppets tie up real capital for weeks. Any identity caught submitting duplicate attestations loses its whole bond, and the plume of penalty funds goes to honest verifiers. Attacker cost scales linearly per fake identity; an honest agent pays once.
